title_sq: Tek Liqeni Farkes Shitet Vile Me Çmim OKAZION, Vetem 1580 Euro/m²
description_sq: Buze liqenit te Farkes, ne nje rezidence te vogel shitet vile me pamje nga Liqeni dhe çmim Okazion. Vila ka 4 kate, oborr dhe parkim per 2 makina. Ne katin 0 ndodhet nje sallon i madh me dalje direkt ne oborrin e gjelberuar, kuzhina e veçuar dhe e paisur mire, nje tualet, nje dhome teknike, nje depo dhe nje ambjent per sauna. Ne katin 1 gjendet salloni i dyte me pamje nga Liqeni dhe nje tualet. Ne katin 2 gjenden dy dhoma gjumi me nje tualet te perbashket dhe nje dhome çifti me tualet te brendshem. Ne katin 3 gjendet nje studio e vogel, tualeti dhe dhoma e miqve me dalje ne verande dhe pamje mbreslenese nga Liqeni. Vila shitet e mobiluar dhe ka dokumentacion te rregullt. Çmimi eshte me i liri ne zonen e Farkes pasi vilat e tjera shiten per 2000 Euro/m2 ndersa vila ne fjale vetem 1580 Euro/m2. Kontakto menjehere ne numrin per me shume informacion!
title_en: Villa for sale at Lake Farkes with a BARGAIN price, only 1580 Euro/m²
description_en: On the edge of the lake of Farka, in a small residence, a villa for sale with a view of the lake and bargain price. The villa has 4 floors, yard and parking for 2 cars. On the 0th floor there is a large living room with direct access to the green courtyard, a separate and well-equipped kitchen, a toilet, a technical room, a storage room and a sauna area. On the 1st floor there is a second living room with a view of the lake and a toilet. On the 2nd floor there are two bedrooms with a shared toilet and a double room with an internal toilet. On the 3rd floor there is a small studio, toilet and guest room with access to the veranda and an impressive view of the lake. The villa is sold furnished and has proper documentation. The price is cheaper in the Farka area, as other villas are sold for 2000 Euro/m2, while the villa in question is only 1580 Euro/m2. Contact the number immediately for more information!
